scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/optional-bindings.mjs && node scripts/deploy-target.mjs production && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging npm run build && node scripts/optional-bindings.mjs && node scripts/deploy-target.mjs staging && wrangler deploy
